blurb: Guests rent SeaDoo Switch pontoon boats to enjoy outdoor water activities on Tampa waterways. Boats are well-maintained and feature the newest SeaDoo designs. Rentals operate seasonally and require a boating safety certificate to operate the console and controls.
extraNote: All boats must be back prior to dusk; late fees $5 per minute after return time · All boats must be refueled prior to return at the marina gas dock · If inclement weather makes boating unsafe, rentals may be rescheduled with notification and alternatives · Seasonal operation
